NextDNS API (1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

URL: https://nextdns.github.io/api/

Unofficial OpenAPI 3.0 reference for the NextDNS API, hand-transcribed from the official docs at https://nextdns.github.io/api/ (no machine-readable spec is published upstream). Regenerate/diff this file against that page when updating — see references/api-reference.md for the update procedure. Examples below are ported verbatim from that page.

Official NextDNS API documentation (source of truth)

Profiles

Root profile object — create/read/update/delete.

Create profile

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
name
string
object (SecuritySettings)

All boolean fields toggle a threat-detection category. NRD = newly registered domains, DGA = domain generation algorithms, DDNS = dynamic DNS, CSAM = child sexual abuse material blocklist.

object (PrivacySettings)
object (ParentalControlSettings)
Array of objects (ListItemRef)
Array of objects (ListItemRef)
object (Settings)

Responses

https://api.nextdns.io/profiles

Update privacy settings

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
path Parameters
profile
required
string

Profile ID (e.g. abc123)

Request Body schema: application/json
Array of objects (ListItemRef)

Third-party/curated tracker+ad blocklists by ID (e.g. nextdns-recommended, oisd).

Array of objects (ListItemRef)

OS/vendor-native telemetry blockers by ID (e.g. apple, huawei, samsung, windows, roku).

disguisedTrackers
boolean

Block trackers that disguise themselves as first-party via CNAME cloaking.

allowAffiliate
boolean

Allow affiliate/tracking links to resolve normally.

Responses

https://api.nextdns.io/profiles/{profile}/privacy

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "blocklists": [
    • {
      • "id": "string",
      • "active": true
      }
    ],
  • "natives": [
    • {
      • "id": "string",
      • "active": true
      }
    ],
  • "disguisedTrackers": true,
  • "allowAffiliate": true
}

https://api.nextdns.io/profiles/{profile}/parentalControl

Update parental control settings

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
path Parameters
profile
required
string

Profile ID (e.g. abc123)

Request Body schema: application/json
Array of objects (ListItemRef)

Named apps/platforms to block (e.g. tiktok, facebook, netflix).

Array of objects (ListItemRef)

Content categories to block (e.g. porn, social-networks, gambling).

safeSearch
boolean
youtubeRestrictedMode
boolean
blockBypass
boolean

Prevent bypassing blocks via known bypass techniques (e.g. DNS-over-HTTPS to a different resolver).

Responses

https://api.nextdns.io/profiles/{profile}/parentalControl

Denylist

User-defined blocked domains.

List denylist entries

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
path Parameters
profile
required
string

Profile ID (e.g. abc123)

query Parameters
limit
integer

Page size. Analytics default 10 (1-500). Logs default 100 (10-1000).

cursor
string

Pagination cursor from a previous response's meta.pagination.cursor.

Responses

https://api.nextdns.io/profiles/{profile}/denylist

Time-series variant of any analytics dimension

Append ;series to any analytics path to get the dimension broken into time buckets instead of one total. data[].queries becomes a parallel array aligned to meta.series.times.

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
path Parameters
profile
required
string

Profile ID (e.g. abc123)

dimension
required
string

Any analytics dimension name (status, domains, reasons, ips, devices, protocols, queryTypes, ipVersions, dnssec, encryption, destinations).

query Parameters
from
string

Inclusive lower-bound date filter. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix seconds/ms, relative offsets (-6h, -1d, -3M, now), or YYYY-MM-DD.

to
string

Exclusive upper-bound date filter. Same formats as from.

interval
string

Time-series only (path suffixed ;series). Tumbling window duration in seconds or duration string.

alignment
string
Default: "end"
Enum: "start" "end" "clock"
timezone
string
Default: "GMT"

IANA timezone name (e.g. Europe/Paris).

partials
string
Default: "none"
Enum: "none" "start" "end" "all"
